title: The Furnace Gate
text: A gate of black iron set in a wall of roaring fire. The latch glows red. It opens only for someone who will hold the latch while the others pass through, and the iron has the shape of many hands burned into it.

options.label: The toughest holds the burning latch, so that the rest may pass.

outcomes.text: They are burned to the elbow, but the party gets through. Their hand-print joins the others in the iron.

options.label: Each Scion takes a turn at the latch, so that no one burns alone.

outcomes.text: Everyone is burned a little, but everyone gets through.

options.label: Find another way, rather than leave your hand in that gate.

outcomes.text: The other way runs through the devils' kennels, where the devils' dogs are awake.
